adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, the component defines a local `const ZAddGuestsInputSchema = z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)` inside the render function. The server-side router uses a different exported `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` from `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts` with shape `{ bookingId: number, guests: string[] }`. While the identical name does not create a direct runtime conflict (different modules/scopes) and the client schema is only used to validate the email array before calling `mutate({ bookingId, guests })`, it does create two diff-grounded “sources of truth” for validation semantics (client enforces uniqueness; server schema doesn’t) and needlessly re-creates the zod schema on every render.
